stages.title: Filter
stages.says: The role’s labels, which the engine applies inside both searches. Of the units they hold back, only the count leaves the server.

stages.title: Dense
stages.says: Cosine between the question’s vector and every vector the filter passes.

stages.title: Lexical
stages.says: BM25, its weights counted over the role’s own view of the corpus.

stages.title: Fused
stages.says: Reciprocal rank fusion of both lists, in the searches’ own round trip to the engine.

stages.title: Reranked
stages.says: A cross encoder reads the question with each fused unit.

stages.title: Excerpts
stages.says: The first units joined with their neighbours: what the model is shown.

stages.title: Answer
stages.says: The model’s reply, read for its answer and its citations.

stages.title: Verdict
stages.says: The registered scorer, for a dev golden question asked as its own role.
